implementation.name: MC6809 / MC6809E (Greg Miller)
implementation.notes: license_id deliberately omitted: the work is dual-licensed and the author requires the user to choose. https://github.com/cavnex/mc6809/blob/master/documentation/LICENSE.md offers either a "stock BSD license" (Copyright (c) 2016, Greg Miller; three conditions, but with a non-endorsement clause worded differently from the SPDX BSD-3-Clause template) or a binary-only modified licence, and says "You must select one." A single-valued license_id cannot express that offer without picking for the user, so it is left empty. accuracy_id from the README title "Cycle Accurate MC6809 Core" and the text "Beyond merely cycle-accurate, the goal was to attempt to preserve as much of the actual bus signals and protocols as possible" (DMABREQ, TSC, MRDY, LIC). The README describes matching bus traffic against a logic analyser on real MC6809/MC6809E parts, but verified_against_hardware is left unset because no specific test result is cited.
